questions.stem: A production aisle repeatedly becomes slick from a leaking process line. Crews mop it several times per shift. What is the strongest corrective action?
options: Repair or contain the leak and provide a surface and drainage design that prevents recurrent contamination, while using interim controls
Increase mopping frequency indefinitely without correcting the source
Post a permanent “slippery when wet” sign and accept the leak
Require workers to walk more slowly as the sole control
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Housekeeping is important, but recurrent contamination requires source correction and engineered drainage or containment rather than perpetual cleanup and warnings.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The option 'Increase mopping frequency indefinitely without correcting the source' does not apply the controlling principle for walking surface housekeeping to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.
The option 'Post a permanent “slippery when wet” sign and accept the leak' does not apply the controlling principle for walking surface housekeeping to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.
The option 'Require workers to walk more slowly as the sole control' does not apply the controlling principle for walking surface housekeeping to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

questions.stem: A floor opening is temporarily uncovered for material transfer. Workers will pass nearby, and the cover is stored across the room. What should be done?
options: Rely on verbal warnings because the opening is temporary
Guard the opening or install a secured, load-capable, marked cover before exposing workers to the area
Place an empty pallet beside the opening as a visual cue
Allow access if workers wear high-visibility clothing
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Openings require positive guarding or a suitable secured cover. Temporary duration and visibility do not prevent a fall.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The option 'Rely on verbal warnings because the opening is temporary' does not apply the controlling principle for floor opening protection to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.
The option 'Place an empty pallet beside the opening as a visual cue' does not apply the controlling principle for floor opening protection to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.
The option 'Allow access if workers wear high-visibility clothing' does not apply the controlling principle for floor opening protection to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

8 feet

Require workers to walk more slowly as the sole control
Increase mopping frequency indefinitely without correcting the source
Post a permanent “slippery when wet” sign and accept the leak
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Housekeeping is important, but recurrent contamination requires source correction and engineered drainage or containment rather than perpetual cleanup and warnings.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Require workers to walk more slowly as the sole control' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling walking surface housekeeping principle.

questions.stem: At a portable ladder selection, a supervisor proposes: "Place an empty pallet beside the opening as a visual cue". The underlying case is: A floor opening is temporarily uncovered for material transfer. Workers will pass nearby, and the cover is stored across the room. What should be done? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Place an empty pallet beside the opening as a visual cue
Guard the opening or install a secured, load-capable, marked cover before exposing workers to the area
Allow access if workers wear high-visibility clothing
Rely on verbal warnings because the opening is temporary
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Openings require positive guarding or a suitable secured cover. Temporary duration and visibility do not prevent a fall.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Place an empty pallet beside the opening as a visual cue' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling floor opening protection principle.
The proposed response 'Allow access if workers wear high-visibility clothing' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling floor opening protection principle.
The proposed response 'Rely on verbal warnings because the opening is temporary' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling floor opening protection principle.

questions.stem: At a roof-work planning meeting, a supervisor proposes: "A near-vertical angle is required whenever the ladder extends above a landing". The underlying case is: A non-self-supporting ladder is set with its base extremely close to the wall, making the ladder nearly vertical. What risk is increased? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: A near-vertical angle is required whenever the ladder extends above a landing
The ladder becomes stronger because vertical loading increases its rating
The base can slide outward or the user can fall backward because the ladder is not set at a stable angle
The only concern is that the ladder will be too short
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Straight and extension ladders need a stable setup angle, firm footing, and secure support; an excessively steep ladder is unstable.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'A near-vertical angle is required whenever the ladder extends above a landing' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling portable ladder angle principle.
The proposed response 'The ladder becomes stronger because vertical loading increases its rating' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling portable ladder angle principle.
The proposed response 'The only concern is that the ladder will be too short' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling portable ladder angle principle.

questions.stem: At a guardrail system audit, a supervisor proposes: "Leave it unchanged because workers can hold the roof edge". The underlying case is: An extension ladder is used to access a roof, but its side rails stop at the roof edge and there are no grab rails. What is the proper correction? options: Ask workers to jump from the top rung to the roof quickly
Leave it unchanged because workers can hold the roof edge
Place a loose board on the top rung to create a handhold
Extend the rails sufficiently above the landing or provide an equivalent secure grasping arrangement and secure the ladder
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Safe transition at an upper landing requires adequate rail extension or an equivalent handhold and a stable, secured ladder.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Ask workers to jump from the top rung to the roof quickly' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling ladder top access principle.
The proposed response 'Leave it unchanged because workers can hold the roof edge' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling ladder top access principle.

Treat the system as a substitute for safe ladder condition and access design
Allow employees to climb outside the system when carrying tools

questions.stem: At a walking-working surface inspection, a supervisor proposes: "Use the rail until an employee reports that it has failed". The underlying case is: A guardrail top rail is at the expected height but is loosely attached and deflects under light force. Which conclusion is correct? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Use the rail until an employee reports that it has failed
Height alone is insufficient; the system must meet strength and construction requirements and be repaired before reliance
Tie caution tape to the rail to restore structural capacity
The rail is compliant because measurement is the only guardrail criterion
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Guardrails must resist required loads and maintain their protective geometry. A weak rail can create false confidence and cannot be accepted based on height alone.

The proposed response 'Tie caution tape to the rail to restore structural capacity' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling guardrail system integrity principle.
The proposed response 'The rail is compliant because measurement is the only guardrail criterion' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling guardrail system integrity principle.

Warning lines eliminate the need for training and supervision
A warning line is not a universal substitute; the selected system must be permitted for the roofing work and configured with required setbacks and supplementary controls
Any visible line is equivalent to a guardrail
